fields.key: stable identifier used in URL hashes and tests
fields.label: human-readable display name
fields.hbm_gb: HBM capacity per GPU in GB
fields.hbm_bw_gbs: peak HBM bandwidth per GPU in GB/s
fields.ici_bw_gbs: peak inter-chip bandwidth per GPU in GB/s. Dual semantics: NVLink bidir on NVLink-capable cards (A100, H100, H200); PCIe bidir on PCIe-only cards (T4, L4, A10G). Each row's `notes` field calls out which one applies. Used in Y_max = F/(B·β) where β = hbm_bw_gbs / ici_bw_gbs
fields.fp16_tflops: peak dense BF16/FP16 tensor TFLOPs (no sparsity)
fields.fp8_tflops: peak dense FP8 tensor TFLOPs; null if hardware has no FP8 path
fields.nvlink: true if multi-GPU TP within node has high-bandwidth interconnect
fields.price_per_hour_usd: AWS on-demand list price per GPU per hour. Derived from the canonical EC2 instance price for this card (us-east-1 list) divided by GPU count on that instance. Default; the UI accepts overrides for spot / reserved / contract pricing.

_sources: NVIDIA datasheets (T4, L4, A100, H100, H200, all SXM where applicable). A10G specifically: official AWS/NVIDIA A10G datasheet PDF at https://d1.awsstatic.com/product-marketing/ec2/NVIDIA_AWS_A10G_DataSheet_FINAL_02_17_2022.pdf (verified 2026-05-23) — A10G is AWS-custom and differs from the regular A10 (dense FP16 ≈ 70 TF on A10G vs 125 TF on A10).
MODEL_SIZING_SCALING_REFERENCE.md §1 (H100 SXM = 9.9e14 FLOPs, 3.35e12 B/s HBM; H200 = 4.8e12 B/s)

MODEL_SIZING_SCALING_REFERENCE.md §6 Y_max derivation — only the TPU v5e β ≈ 8 is taken from the Scaling Book; all other β values (H100 ≈ 3.7, H200 ≈ 5.3, A100 ≈ 3.4, etc.) are derived in-place as hbm_bw_gbs / ici_bw_gbs using the §1 bandwidth values, not quoted from the book.

AWS EC2 on-demand pricing (us-east-1, list) cross-checked via instances.vantage.sh on 2026-05-23. T4 g4dn.xlarge $0.526/hr, L4 g6.xlarge $0.805/hr, A10G g5.xlarge $1.006/hr, A100-40GB p4d.24xlarge $21.958/hr (÷8 = $2.745), A100-80GB p4de.24xlarge $27.447/hr (÷8 = $3.431), H100-80GB p5.48xlarge $55.04/hr (÷8 = $6.88). H200 p5e.48xlarge on-demand list price not directly published; derived from AWS Capacity Blocks (https://aws.amazon.com/ec2/capacityblocks/pricing/, fetched 2026-05-23) ratio H200/H100 = $4.975/$4.326 = 1.15× applied to H100 on-demand → $7.91/GPU.

hardware.label: T4 (g4dn)
hardware.notes: Turing; no hardware FP8 path. Reference for Stage 2 g4dn.xlarge spot work. ici_bw_gbs is PCIe-bidir, not NVLink (no NVLink on this card). Price: g4dn.xlarge on-demand list; override in UI for spot / contract.

hardware.label: L4 (g6)
hardware.notes: Ada Lovelace; FP8 supported. PCIe only — no NVLink even in multi-GPU configs. ici_bw_gbs is PCIe-bidir, not NVLink (no NVLink on this card). Price: g6.xlarge on-demand list; override in UI for spot / contract.

hardware.label: A10G (g5)
hardware.notes: Price: g5.xlarge on-demand list; override in UI for spot / contract. Ampere; AWS-custom variant — verified against official AWS/NVIDIA A10G datasheet (https://d1.awsstatic.com/product-marketing/ec2/NVIDIA_AWS_A10G_DataSheet_FINAL_02_17_2022.pdf) on 2026-05-23: 24 GB GDDR6 (field is named hbm_gb but A10G uses GDDR6, not HBM), 600 GB/s memory bandwidth, PCIe Gen4 64 GB/s bidir interconnect (no NVLink), BFLOAT16/FP16 Tensor Core = 70 TF dense (140 TF with 2:4 sparsity — we store dense). No FP8 — Hopper introduced FP8. Note: A10G is the AWS-custom variant; dense FP16 is ~half the regular A10's 125 TF (cross-checked against https://www.baseten.co/blog/nvidia-a10-vs-a10g-for-ml-model-inference/). Previous value of 125 TF was the A10, not A10G — corrected 2026-05-23.

hardware.label: A100 40GB (SXM4)
hardware.notes: Ampere; NVLink 3.0 = 600 GB/s bidir within DGX/HGX. No FP8 — Hopper introduced FP8. Price: p4d.24xlarge on-demand list ($21.958/hr ÷ 8 GPUs); override in UI for spot / contract.

hardware.label: A100 80GB (SXM4)
hardware.notes: Same compute as 40GB; doubled HBM lifts the roofline ridge point. NVLink 3.0 = 600 GB/s bidir. Price: p4de.24xlarge on-demand list ($27.447/hr ÷ 8 GPUs); override in UI for spot / contract.

hardware.label: H100 80GB (SXM5)
hardware.notes: Hopper SXM; per reference §1, B_crit ≈ 295 (bf16) / 590 (fp8 weights, bf16 acts). NVLink 4.0 = 900 GB/s bidir → β ≈ 3.7. Price: p5.48xlarge on-demand list ($55.04/hr ÷ 8 GPUs); override in UI for spot / contract.

hardware.label: H200 141GB (SXM5)
hardware.notes: Same compute as H100, ~43% more HBM and ~43% more bandwidth. Reference §1: B_crit ≈ 205 (bf16). NVLink 4.0 = 900 GB/s bidir → β ≈ 5.3. Price: derived from AWS Capacity Blocks ratio H200/H100 = $4.975/$4.326 = 1.15× (https://aws.amazon.com/ec2/capacityblocks/pricing/) applied to known H100 on-demand $6.88/GPU → $7.91/GPU. p5en.48xlarge enhanced-networking variant runs higher (~$9/GPU). Override in UI for spot / Capacity Blocks / contract.
